name: mempalace_status
description: Palace overview — total drawers, wing and room counts

name: mempalace_list_wings
description: List all wings with drawer counts

name: mempalace_list_rooms
description: List rooms within a wing (or all rooms if no wing given)

name: mempalace_get_taxonomy
description: Full taxonomy: wing → room → drawer count

name: mempalace_get_aaak_spec
description: Get the AAAK dialect specification — the compressed memory format MemPalace uses. Call this if you need to read or write AAAK-compressed memories.

name: mempalace_kg_query
description: Query the knowledge graph for an entity's relationships. Returns typed facts with temporal validity. E.g. 'Max' → child_of Alice, loves chess, does swimming. Filter by date with as_of to see what was true at a point in time.

as_of.description: Date/datetime filter — only facts valid at this time (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optional)

name: mempalace_kg_add
description: Add a fact to the knowledge graph. Subject → predicate → object with optional time window. E.g. ('Max', 'started_school', 'Year 7', valid_from='2026-09-01'). Pass valid_to to backfill an already-ended historical fact in a single call.

valid_from.description: When this became true (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optional)

valid_to.description: When this stopped being true (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optional). Use for backfilling already-ended historical facts.

source_closet.description: Closet ID where this fact appears (optional)

source_file.description: Source file path the fact was extracted from (optional)

source_drawer_id.description: Drawer ID the fact was extracted from (optional, RFC 002 provenance)

name: mempalace_kg_invalidate
description: Mark a fact as no longer true. E.g. ankle injury resolved, job ended, moved house.

ended.description: When it stopped being true (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, default: today)

name: mempalace_kg_supersede
description: Atomically replace a fact with its successor at a shared boundary. Use when a single-valued fact changes (model, employer, address) instead of separate kg_invalidate + kg_add — a point-in-time query at the boundary then returns only the new value.

subject.description: The entity whose fact is changing

at.description: Boundary instant (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ, optional; defaults to now UTC)

name: mempalace_kg_timeline
description: Chronological timeline of facts. Shows the story of an entity (or everything) in order.

entity.description: Entity to get timeline for (optional — omit for full timeline)

name: mempalace_kg_stats
description: Knowledge graph overview: entities, triples, current vs expired facts, relationship types.

name: mempalace_traverse
description: Walk the palace graph from a room. Shows connected ideas across wings — the tunnels. Like following a thread through the palace: start at 'chromadb-setup' in wing_code, discover it connects to wing_myproject (planning) and wing_user (feelings about it).

name: mempalace_find_tunnels
description: Find rooms that bridge two wings — the hallways connecting different domains. E.g. what topics connect wing_code to wing_team?

name: mempalace_graph_stats
description: Palace graph overview: total rooms, tunnel connections, edges between wings.

name: mempalace_create_tunnel
description: Create a cross-wing tunnel linking two palace locations. Use when content in one project relates to another — e.g., an API design in project_api connects to a database schema in project_database.

name: mempalace_list_tunnels
description: List all explicit cross-wing tunnels. Optionally filter by wing.

wing.description: Filter tunnels by wing (shows tunnels where wing is source or target)

name: mempalace_delete_tunnel
description: Delete an explicit tunnel by its ID.

name: mempalace_list_hallways
description: List within-wing hallway records (entity-to-entity co-occurrence links built at mine time). Optionally filter by wing.

name: mempalace_delete_hallway
description: Delete a hallway record by its ID. Returns {deleted: bool}.

name: mempalace_follow_tunnels
description: Follow tunnels from a room to see what it connects to in other wings. Returns connected rooms with drawer previews.

name: mempalace_search
description: Semantic search. Returns verbatim drawer content with similarity scores. IMPORTANT: 'query' must contain ONLY search keywords. Use 'context' for background. Results with cosine distance > max_distance are filtered out.

query.description: Short search query ONLY — keywords or a question. Max 250 chars.

source_file.description: Filter to one exact source_file (optional). Matches the full stored path exactly (leading/trailing whitespace trimmed); no glob or basename matching. Pass the value from a result's 'source_path' field; the displayed 'source_file' is only a basename.

max_distance.description: Max cosine distance threshold (0=identical, 2=opposite). Results further than this are dropped. Lower = stricter. Default 1.5. Set to 0 to disable.

context.description: Background context for the search (optional). NOT used for embedding — only for future re-ranking.

name: mempalace_check_duplicate
description: Check if content already exists in the palace before filing

name: mempalace_add_drawer
description: File verbatim content into the palace. Checks for duplicates first.

content.description: Verbatim content to store — exact words, never summarized

name: mempalace_checkpoint
description: Save a whole session in one call: semantic-dedups each item, files non-duplicates as drawers, then writes one diary entry. Use this instead of many separate check_duplicate/add_drawer/diary_write calls — it renders as a single tool-call card in the host UI.

items.description: Verbatim items to file. Each is {wing, room, content} — content is the exact words, never summarized.

diary.description: Optional diary entry written after filing: {agent_name, entry, topic?, wing?}. entry is AAAK-format.

dedup_threshold.description: Similarity threshold 0-1 for the per-item dedup check (default 0.9)

name: mempalace_delete_drawer
description: Delete a drawer by ID. Irreversible.

drawer_id.description: ID of the drawer to delete

name: mempalace_mine
description: Mine a directory into the palace — the MCP equivalent of `mempalace mine`. mode='projects' (default) ingests code/docs; mode='convos' ingests chat transcripts; mode='extract' ingests office documents (PDF/DOCX/RTF, requires the mempalace[extract] extra). Runs synchronously and returns the miner's summary as `output`. The palace write lock is automatic; a concurrent mine returns a structured already-running error. Orphan cleanup is separate — use mempalace_sync.

mode.description: Ingest mode: projects (code/docs, default), convos (chat transcripts), extract (office docs).

limit.description: Max files to process (0 = all). Default: 0.

dry_run.description: Report what would be filed without writing. Default: false.

extract.description: Convos extraction strategy: exchange (default) or general. Ignored by other modes.

name: mempalace_delete_by_source
description: Bulk-delete every drawer mined from one source_file (exact match). Use to clean up benchmark/test data accidentally mined into a user wing (#1722). Returns a dry-run match count and sample by default; pass dry_run=false to commit. Irreversible.

source_file.description: Exact source_file metadata value to remove (e.g. the full path that was mined)

dry_run.description: Preview the match count without deleting; default true. Pass false to actually delete.

name: mempalace_sync
description: Prune drawers whose source files are gitignored, deleted, or moved. Returns dry-run report by default; pass apply=true to commit deletions.

project_dir.description: Project root to scope the sync (optional; auto-detected from drawer metadata if omitted)

apply.description: Actually delete drawers; default is dry-run preview

name: mempalace_get_drawer
description: Fetch a single drawer by ID — returns full content and metadata.

drawer_id.description: ID of the drawer to fetch

name: mempalace_list_drawers
description: List drawers with pagination. Optional wing/room filter and since/before date filter on filed_at (since inclusive, before exclusive; drawers without a parseable filed_at are excluded when a date bound is set). Returns IDs, wings, rooms, content previews, and total matching count for pagination.

since.description: Only drawers filed on or after this ISO date/time, inclusive (e.g. '2026-04-01'). Optional.

before.description: Only drawers filed before this ISO date/time, exclusive (e.g. '2026-05-01'). Optional.

name: mempalace_update_drawer
description: Update an existing drawer's content and/or metadata (wing, room). Fetches existing drawer first; returns error if not found.

drawer_id.description: ID of the drawer to update

content.description: New content (optional — omit to keep existing)

wing.description: New wing (optional — omit to keep existing)

room.description: New room (optional — omit to keep existing)

name: mempalace_diary_write
description: Write to your personal agent diary in AAAK format. Your observations, thoughts, what you worked on, what matters. Each agent has their own diary with full history. Write in AAAK for compression — e.g. 'SESSION:2026-04-04|built.palace.graph+diary.tools|ALC.req:agent.diaries.in.aaak|★★★'. Use entity codes from the AAAK spec.

agent_name.description: Your name — each agent gets their own diary wing

entry.description: Your diary entry in AAAK format — compressed, entity-coded, emotion-marked

wing.description: Target wing for this diary entry (optional). If omitted, uses wing_{agent_name}. Use this to write diary entries to a project wing instead of an agent-specific wing.

content.description: Alias for 'entry' — accepted because add_drawer uses 'content'. Provide either 'entry' or 'content'; 'entry' wins if both are given.

name: mempalace_diary_read
description: Read your recent diary entries (in AAAK). See what past versions of yourself recorded — your journal across sessions.

agent_name.description: Your name — each agent gets their own diary wing

last_n.description: Number of recent entries to read (default: 10)

wing.description: Wing to read diary entries from (optional). If omitted, reads from wing_{agent_name}.

name: mempalace_hook_settings
description: Get or set hook behavior. silent_save: True = save directly (no MCP clutter), False = legacy blocking. desktop_toast: True = show desktop notification. Call with no args to view.

silent_save.description: True = silent direct save, False = blocking MCP calls

desktop_toast.description: True = show desktop toast via notify-send

name: mempalace_memories_filed_away
description: Check if a recent palace checkpoint was saved. Returns message count and timestamp.

name: mempalace_reconnect
description: Force reconnect to the palace database. Use after external scripts or CLI commands modified the palace directly, which can leave the in-memory HNSW index stale.
